fact: The plan tables LITAS with an expected result of all modules functional and rolled out to all Tax Business Offices.
The plan says LITAS registration, return processing and payment modules are operational and rolled out to one Tax Business Office, and lists e-filing among the LRA's strengths.
The plan says a growing number of taxpayers use direct transfer and mobile money to pay taxes, and lists e-payments among the LRA's strengths.
The joint press conference says the LRA is expanding LITAS across regional tax offices to strengthen domestic tax administration.
LITAS handles taxpayer online filing, assessments and payments, enhanced with mobile payment features, per the Liberia Revenue Authority.
Taxes are paid through LITAS by mobile money and by seven of nine commercial banks connected, with electronic receipts, per the Liberia Revenue Authority.
